Class ExceptionHandlerMethodResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.method.annotation.ExceptionHandlerMethodResolver
public class ExceptionHandlerMethodResolver extends Object
Discovers @ExceptionHandler methods in a given class, including all of its superclasses, and helps to resolve a given Exception and MediaType requested by clients to combinations supported by a given Method.

此解析器将使用声明为 `@ExceptionHandler` 注解属性或作为方法参数的异常信息，后者作为后备方案。如果出现以下情况，将抛出 `IllegalStateException` 实例：

  • 找不到方法的异常信息
  • 已声明了一个无效的MediaType作为@ExceptionHandler属性。
  • 多个处理器声明了相同的异常和媒体类型映射。
Since:
3.1
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Juergen Hoeller，Sam Brannen，Brian Clozel

      public @Nullable Method resolveMethod(Exception exception)

    • resolveExceptionMapping

      public @Nullable ExceptionHandlerMappingInfo resolveExceptionMapping(Throwable exception, MediaType mediaType)
      Find a Method to handle the given Throwable for the requested MediaType.

      如果找到多个匹配项，则使用ExceptionDepthComparator和MediaType.isMoreSpecific(MimeType)。

      Parameters:
      exception - 异常
      mediaType - 由 HTTP 客户端请求的媒体类型
      Returns:
      处理异常的Method，或者如果未找到则为null
      Since:
      6.2

    • resolveMethodByExceptionType

      public @Nullable Method resolveMethodByExceptionType(Class<? extends Throwable> exceptionType)
      Find a Method to handle the given exception type. This can be useful if an Exception instance is not available (for example, for tools).

      如果找到多个匹配项，则使用ExceptionDepthComparator。

      Parameters:
      exceptionType - 异常类型
      Returns:
      处理异常的Method，或者如果未找到则为null

    • resolveExceptionMappingByExceptionType
